name: Cable Girls
description: In 1920s Madrid, four women at the National Telephone Company ring in revolution as they deal with romance, envy and the modern workplace.

videos.title: Chapter 1: Dreams
videos.overview: Lidia is used to being a thief, but now she must steal in order to save her life. Different hopes propel each of the women into the workplace.

videos.title: Chapter 2: Memories
videos.overview: Francisco offers Lidia a deal. Marga worries about what she saw at the party. Carlota's father interferes with her life.

videos.title: Chapter 3: Lies
videos.overview: The police are called in when Lidia's identity is questioned. Francisco's wife is suspicious and asks Carolina for help.

videos.title: Chapter 4: Feelings
videos.overview: Marga makes a lunch date with Pablo. Ángeles learns more about Mario's infidelity. Carlota's fantasies surprise her.

videos.title: Chapter 5: The Past
videos.overview: Carolina threatens to reveal who Lidia really is. Miguel tells Carlota she must decide about their relationship. Everything changes for Ángeles.

videos.title: Chapter 6: Family
videos.overview: Lidia helps Ángeles plan her escape. Carlota works to get Sara released from jail. Carlos fights with his father.

videos.title: Chapter 7: Loss
videos.overview: The Cifuentes family mourns their loss. Lidia decides she should be honest with Carlos about her identity.

videos.title: Chapter 8: Love
videos.overview: The new rotary technology divides Lidia's loyalties, and she is forced to choose between Carlos and her friends.

videos.title: Chapter 9: The Choice
videos.overview: As 1928 turns into 1929, Lidia reports to a new boss, Carlota is blackmailed, Marga gets a hidden surprise, and all three rush to Angeles's rescue.

videos.title: Chapter 10: Pact
videos.overview: Lidia directs a cover-up plan, but a theft complicates things and Marga is later caught in a lie. Carlos and Francisco negotiate an alliance.

videos.title: Chapter 11: Jealousy
videos.overview: Marisol tries to drive Marga and Pablo apart. Carlota becomes suspicious of Sara. Lidia noticed a crucial difference between Carlos and Francisco.

videos.title: Chapter 12: Guilt
videos.overview: Sara reveals a secret to Carlota. Angeles learns Inspector Cuevas's weakness. Pablo shows Marga his undying love. Lidia helps end an operator strike.

videos.title: Chapter 13: Secrets
videos.overview: Sarah seeks medical advice. Lidia gets news that complicates her choice between Francisco and Carlos. Marga learns Pablo is hiding a delicate problem.

videos.title: Chapter 14: Loneliness
videos.overview: Lidia gets a tempting offer. Carlota and her friends respond to a plea for help. Angeles takes a risky step in order to learn the witness's identity.

videos.title: Chapter 15: Opportunities
videos.overview: The police find a body. Angeles learns who's been spooking her. Francisco gives Lidia space, while Carlos gives her a surprise. An arrest is made.

videos.title: Chapter 16: Innocence
videos.overview: Carlota gets news about Miguel. Guilt-stricken Marga goes into seclusion. Lidia learns Francisco has made a decision. Angeles finds herself cornered.

videos.title: Chapter 17: Time
videos.overview: Six months later, a catastrophic event deeply affects Lidia, Marga, Carlota, Angeles and their loved ones. Marga gets a surprise visit from an in-law.

videos.title: Chapter 18: Death
videos.overview: With her friends' help, Lidia puts her plan into action. Carlota decides what to do with her inheritance. Angeles tries to earn Pedro Guzman's trust.

videos.title: Chapter 19: Truth
videos.overview: Lidia's desperation worries Carlota and spurs Francisco to offer support. Marga helps Julio cover Pablo's job. Carlota finds a way to promote her cause.

videos.title: Chapter 20: Revenge
videos.overview: Lidia and Francisco visit an orphanage to gather info. Complications arise with Marga when Julio impersonates housebound Pablo, who sneaks back to work.

videos.title: Chapter 21: Sin
videos.overview: Angeles must deflect Guzman's suspicion of a mole. Carlos learns his mother's car was sabotaged and confronts Lidia. Marga has a horrible realization.

videos.title: Chapter 22: Fight
videos.overview: To protect her child, Angeles accepts a deal with Guzman. A phone call gives Lidia a hunch on Eva's whereabouts. Carlota responds to her attackers.

videos.title: Chapter 23: Hope
videos.overview: Lidia turns the tables on her captor. During the king's visit, those fighting for Carlota's cause take drastic measures, forcing her to choose sides.

videos.title: Chapter 24: Destiny
videos.overview: As the situation escalates, Lidia tries to get to Eva, Marga shocks Pablo, Carlota takes a risk, Angeles learn a truth and Francisco attempts a rescue.

videos.title: Chapter 25: Equality
videos.overview: Carlota's new political career faces a major obstacle as Marga suffers heartbreak. Meanwhile, Lidia returns to work and Ángeles pitches an idea to her.

videos.title: Chapter 26: Liberty
videos.overview: As her memory starts to slowly come back, Carlota's friends try to clear her name. Ángeles begins teaching classes. Lidia's former enemy returns.

videos.title: Chapter 27: Justice
videos.overview: Lidia and Carlos argue over a loved one's medical treatment. Óscar makes a shocking discovery about Dulce. Marga gets to know her boss better.

videos.title: Chapter 28: Fear
videos.overview: With Carlota's future looking perilous, Óscar starts falsifying evidence to get her out of prison. A different doctor gives Lidia new hope.

videos.title: Chapter 29: Life
videos.overview: The friends begin concocting a plan to free Óscar from prison and Marga turns to Pablo for assistance. Carlos is surprised by his friend's condition.

videos.title: Chapter 30: Doubt
videos.overview: Carmen creates a deception while Carlos continues to keep Lidia in the dark. Carlota tries desperately to escape from her captor.

videos.title: Chapter 31: Happiness
videos.overview: Lidia is confused and hurt by Carlos's betrayal. An unlikely ally is enlisted to try to free Óscar. Carmen's calculating plan starts falling into place.

videos.title: Chapter 32: Luck
videos.overview: When the prison break is set in motion, the team faces unforeseen consequences. Lidia makes a heartbreaking decision in order to protect Eva.

videos.title: Chapter 33: War
videos.overview: Lidia leaves New York and returns to Madrid in search of Sofía, who has run away to join the Republicans in the Spanish Civil War.

videos.title: Chapter 34: Hate
videos.overview: Lidia's friends — both old and new — help her attempt to force Carlos to call Sofía back from the front lines. Pablo looks for ways to avoid enlisting.

videos.title: Chapter 35: Courage
videos.overview: Óscar and Carlota risk their journalistic integrity in exchange for helping Lidia with Sofía. Marga falls ill while running a dangerous errand.

videos.title: Chapter 36: Control
videos.overview: Carlos and Lidia encounter trouble in their search for Sofía. Carlota visits the western front with James, to Óscar's chagrin. Pablo goes missing.

videos.title: Chapter 37: Insanity
videos.overview: When Madrid falls to the Nationalists, Lidia and most of her friends must face widespread grief and devastation, with long-term consequences.

videos.title: Chapter 38: Power
videos.overview: Lidia's defiance gets her into trouble at the prison camp, while Francisco concocts a plan to free her. Marga confides her secrets to Isidro.

videos.title: Chapter 39: Patience
videos.overview: Lidia is desperate to save her imprisoned friend. Elisa discloses Carlos' fate. Marga realizes who betrayed her. Carmen targets Lidia's loved ones.

videos.title: Chapter 40: Pain
videos.overview: Elisa reveals a startling secret as more of Lidia's friends are endangered. Sofía turns to an old friend for help protecting the prisoners from Carmen.

videos.title: Chapter 41: Defeat
videos.overview: An unexpected ally seeking the ultimate revenge helps Lidia try and enact her plan to free all the  prisoners from the women's prison camp.

videos.title: Chapter 42: The End
videos.overview: When the final phase of their escape plan is threatened, Lidia, Carlota, Marga and Óscar make a momentous decision together.
